description: Utility functions for file handling in Mattermost, including file size constants, file type detection from MIME types, filename trimming, EXIF orientation extraction, and feature enablement checks based on user agent and configuration.

methods.name: canUploadFiles
methods.description: Determines if files can be uploaded based on configuration and user agent.

methods.name: isFileAttachmentsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file attachments are enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: isMobileFileUploadsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if mobile file uploads are enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: isPublicLinksEnabled
methods.description: Checks if public links are enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: canDownloadFiles
methods.description: Determines if files can be downloaded based on configuration and user agent.

methods.name: trimFilename
methods.description: Trims filename to maximum length defined in constants, appending ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: getFileTypeFromMime
methods.description: Returns a file type category based on MIME type string.

methods.name: getExifOrientation
methods.description: Extracts EXIF orientation data from image ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: getOrientationStyles
methods.description: Returns CSS transform styles based on EXIF orientation.
